qualification: FilesPaneService owns one serialized worker, latest navigation/page slots, one unread reply and coalesced payload-free wakes. Exact opaque identity tokens distinguish even equal numeric counters from different services. Navigation supersedes old requests/results; reads cannot interrupt navigation or overwrite unread replies. Read tickets and model stamps remain separate gates.

Backend factories lazily open source/workspace only on the worker. Native production configuration uses NativeFileSystem, open_native_index_workspace, explicit existing cache address and the platform native storage-query namespace. No default temp path, insecure cache, filesystem-label inference, source writes or UI-thread native owner retirement.

Navigation builds a separate indexed pane and a complete requested first page before a short model exchange. The old model and active location survive failure, cancellation before commitment and first-page text/wire limits. Native IO and destruction stay outside the transport mutex. Cancellation racing already committed work does not undo it. Requested/active addresses are distinct in replies.

Resource limits cover native path/filter sizes, directory rows, shared cache bytes/files (old view plus staging), page rows/text/wire bytes and diagnostic strings. Short wire-budget captures cannot publish partial requested viewports. Native errors retain exact state/domain/code/operation and win concurrent cancellation. Oversized diagnostics are explicit limit failures, never truncated successes.

Worker exceptions poison the service, release all native owners and issue allocation-free terminal fault records. A failed callback triggers one final fault notification; state remains pollable if notification itself fails. Stop requests do not join or interrupt blocked OS calls; running remains true until actual worker retirement. The composition root must join outside UI dispatch after withdrawing callbacks.

Seventeen new tests: real native source/cache on all hosts; worker-only creation/IO/final retirement;100 queued navigations while a source open blocks;50 coalesced page requests while a cache read blocks; old-view preservation; native failure versus cancellation; foreign tickets/stamps/out-of-range reads; bounded unread replies/wakes; nonblocking stop and join; allocation/exception/callback faults; workspace/path/text/diagnostic and short-wire limits.

limitations: WP02 remains in progress. The actual two-pane application/controller, lifetime-checked bounded UI publication, focus/mark/reorder and qualified refresh commands, child navigation/completion, properties/preview, histories/bookmarks, user settings and real-terminal acceptance remain required. No production Files executable is introduced.

Current service operations are explicit navigation and bounded page reads. A fresh navigation is not the required refresh policy; application refresh must preserve qualified selections or explicitly report invalidation. Read-only view stamps/tickets are not source inventory, content snapshots, mutable-entry bindings or mutation/loss-consent authority.

Cancellation is cooperative; a blocked native call can delay shutdown. Join/destruction wait and must be used outside dispatch by the composition owner. Backend factories must capture value configuration and avoid retaining worker-created native owners. Clients must bound retained replies and validate both service tickets and stamps.

Limits bound the documented transport/query/cache payloads, not total process RSS or arbitrary caller-owned callback captures. The cache ledger includes old and staged views, so a replacement view can fail its resource budget while preserving the old one. Complete-provider/slow-storage/full-disk and application-scale performance qualification remain WP07 work.

Native positive service integration uses private APFS/ext4/ReFS source/cache fixtures on these hosts. All other filesystems/providers and complete application fault/lifecycle behavior still require their own qualification. WP03 planning/scoped consent and WP04–08 mutations/recovery/release remain open.
